glosses: even if one wanted to …, (one can't)
patterns.usage_note: Concedes an intention and then blocks it: the volitional plus にも sets up an attempt whose second half is almost always the potential negative of the same verb (帰ろうにも帰れない), and the obstacle is outside circumstance rather than the speaker's own reluctance. Against 〜たくても〜ない, which is about thwarted desire, this frame says the attempt itself is impossible; both halves normally share one subject. Godan verbs give the うに shape, while ichidan and する verbs surface as 〜ようにも (起きようにも, 相談しようにも).

examples.ruby: 終電[しゅうでん]を逃[のが]して、帰[かえ]ろうにも帰[かえ]れなくなった。
examples.english: I missed the last train, so now I couldn't get home even if I wanted to.

examples.ruby: 熱[ねつ]でふらふらして、立[た]とうにも立[た]てない。
examples.english: I'm so light-headed with fever I couldn't stand up if I tried.

examples.ruby: レシートがないので、返品[へんぴん]を頼[たの]もうにも頼[たの]めない。
examples.english: I don't have the receipt, so there's no asking for a refund even if I wanted to.
